C0797.title: Microsoft Investigates Stealthy Intrusion via Third-Party Vendor Management Relationships
C0797.summary: On May 12, 2026, Microsoft Incident Response published a case study on a stealthy intrusion in which a threat actor used a compromised third-party IT services provider and legitimate IT management tools. Microsoft said the attack abused trusted relationships, identity infrastructure, and operational tooling, with objectives including long-term access, credential theft, and persistence.
